name: evidence-card-viewport-stability
goal: Keep component screenshot frames at a consistent 4:3 card size across desktop, tablet, and mobile captures while containing each original image without distortion.

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Existing EntityScreens renders each captured screenshot at width 100% and height auto. The 1440×900 desktop, 920×800 tablet, and 390×844 mobile sources therefore change the screenshot card height when selected. Expected: a shared 4:3 frame at the same available width, with each source fully contained and no distortion; portrait captures receive side gutters. Reproduce at the TitleList component detail and select each Viewport control.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: The standardized explorer evidence E2E test selected Mobile but asserted only that an image existed. It never compared the screenshot frame geometry after viewport selection or checked object-fit. Strengthen that same browser flow using the seeded 1440×900, 920×800, and 390×844 captures; assert a common 4:3 frame, contained images, unchanged frame dimensions while switching, and measurable mobile side gutters.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
